description: Classification of one image region extracted from a scanned financial/legal document. Transcribe, identify, and never guess -- 'illegible' is a valid answer, an invented one is not.

description.description: One sentence: what is visibly in this region.

text_in_image.description: Every legible word in the region, verbatim -- including text inside logos, stamps, and handwritten marks. 'illegible' where unreadable.

organization_identified.description: When a logo, letterhead, or seal identifies an organization: its name. This often identifies the document's issuer more reliably than body text.

date_visible.description: Any date inside the region (stamp dates especially), YYYY-MM-DD or verbatim.

signature_details.description: For signatures: printed name beneath it if any, title, and whether the signature line is signed or blank.

relevance.description: What this region tells us about the document: 'IRS eagle seal -- confirms federal issuer', 'RECEIVED stamp dated 2022-11-03 -- proves delivery date', 'signed by escrow officer'.
